spec.situation_desc: had a loan application declined with no explanation

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Thistle Bank, Jordan speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Imran Rahman. My loan application’s been declined and nobody’s explained why. I’m really unhappy with how the bank’s handled it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry it’s left you feeling that way, Imran. I’ll look into it with you. Before we discuss the application, could you confirm your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks, that’s verified. I can see why you’d expect a clearer explanation. I’m sure the loan funds will be released once I get this checked.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: That’s quite a promise when you haven’t even checked what happened. I just want someone to take responsibility and tell me why I was turned down.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’re right, I shouldn’t get ahead of the checks. I’ll take ownership and ask our lending team to review the decision and explain it. I’ll put a note on your account as well.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: All right, but I don’t want this brushed off again.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand. I’ll send the review to the lending team today, and I’ll call you by 5pm next Wednesday, the 28th, with an update, even if they haven’t finished.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: And when will I get an actual answer?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’ll receive a full written response within eight weeks. I’ll make sure the team has your concerns and the details of the application to review.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Okay. I’m still not happy, but at least that’s a clear timeframe.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: So, I’ll ask lending to review the decline today, add a note to your account, and call you by 5pm next Wednesday with an update. A full written response will arrive within eight weeks. Does that all make sense?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’re welcome, Imran. I’m sorry again for the frustration, and I’ll follow it through.
